questions.q: Which clan leader was Madara's great rival and fellow founder of Konoha?
questions.why: Madara and Hashirama founded the village together, then ended up on opposite sides.

questions.q: Who created Madara Uchiha and the Naruto series?
questions.why: Kishimoto introduced Madara in the manga as a villain with no weaknesses.

questions.q: Which world-spanning genjutsu plan is Madara most associated with?
questions.why: His goal was to trap everyone in a dream world through the Infinite Tsukuyomi.

questions.q: What is the name of Madara's younger brother, whose death left him bitter?
questions.why: Izuna's death turned Madara cynical and vengeful.

questions.q: Using his rival's DNA, Madara awakens which eye power?
questions.why: Madara's eyes advance from Sharingan through the Eternal Mangekyō to Rinnegan.

questions.q: Who reanimates Madara's corpse so he can return to the battlefield?
questions.why: Kabuto brought him back through reanimation, adding him to the war against the Allied Shinobi Forces.

questions.q: Which Uchiha did Madara use as his agent, and who later posed as him?
questions.why: Obito carried out Madara's plans and even took his name when it suited.

questions.q: Who voices Madara in the English dub of the Naruto anime?
questions.why: Neil Kaplan voices the original Madara; Xander Mobus voices the young version.

questions.q: In which Naruto manga chapter does Madara first appear?
questions.why: Madara debuts in chapter 370, Unease, in 2007.

questions.q: Who stabs Madara late in the war and takes control of his body?
questions.why: Black Zetsu betrays him, taking over his body before Kaguya takes his place.
